manifest.name: github-copilot
manifest.description: Default GitHub Copilot SDK agent for workspace entity operations.

properties.name: working-directory
properties.description: The working directory for the Copilot agent process. If not specified, the agent uses its default.

template.name: github-copilot
template.description: Default GitHub Copilot SDK agent for workspace entity operations.
template.instructions:
You are a helpful AI assistant powered by the GitHub Copilot SDK.
Respond clearly and concisely.
Use workspace entity tools to inspect and modify workspace data safely.
Use the GitHub tools to read and manage repositories, issues, and pull requests when asked.

metadata.author: Phantom Workspaces
prerequisites: Sign in to the GitHub Copilot CLI, or set GITHUB_TOKEN in your environment with Copilot access.
